facts.content: Acute severe headache, probable migraine with aura lasting 3 days, unresponsive to OTC ibuprofen, with no red flags.
facts.source_text: 1) Acute severe headache, probable migraine with aura (photophobia, visual phenomena), first prolonged episode (3 days), refractory to OTC ibuprofen; no red flags elicited (no fever, meningismus, focal deficits, thunderclap, nocturnal awakening), but requires in-person neuro exam and fundoscopic exam.

facts.content: Combined oral contraceptive use may be contraindicated if migraine with aura is confirmed.
